_comment: Copy to config/broker.json on the GPU PC and start the broker by hand: npm run broker. It is the only way to the GPU: every installation's ComfyUI provider points at it ("baseUrl": "http://<this PC>:8190", "broker": true) and ComfyUI listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Requests from this PC need no token (client "local"); every other client sends Authorization: Bearer <its token> ("env:NAME" reads an environment variable). See docs/gpu-broker.md.
